description: Swipe on the current mobile screen. Direction is up/down/left/right; optional from-point and distance default to a center-screen swipe of ~60% of the relevant axis. Coordinates are device-space by default — keep it that way and pass ceraph_snapshot `bounds` directly. Only pass coordinateSource: 'screenshot' if `from` was measured off a screenshot, and treat that as best-effort: the delivered image is usually downscaled by a factor Ceraph cannot observe.

from.description: Optional swipe start point. Defaults to screen center.

projectDir.description: React Native/Expo project directory. Omit when the coding client's workspace identifies one app; supply it to disambiguate projects.

name: screen_swipe
